question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Though he is stout, he runs _______.
solution:
The correct answer: **fast.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fast** means moving or capable of moving at high speed.
 
• **“Fast”** is generally used for actions that are more sustained.
 
• Here **"fast"** is an adverb because it modifies the verb **'run'**.
 
• The given sentence is in the simple present form, so **'fast'** (V₁) should be used.
 
 
• **Example -** The athlete runs really **fast**.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

**Complete sentence:** *Though he is stout, he runs **fast__**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **"Faster"** is the comparative degree of **"fast"**. It is used when we compare speed between two persons or objects.
 
• **"Fastest"** is the superlative degree of **"fast"**. It is used If we were talking about more than two drives and showing superiority.
 
• The fact is that there is no such word as **“fastly”**. **“Fast”** is already both an adjective and an adverb.
